notes.title: Verified for the Deck!
notes.content:
Hello dear kebab lovers!

We've been working on an update aiming to make the game run well on the Steam Deck, and we would like to announce that it is now live and the game is marked as verified. 
You can chase the kebab anywhere you go, even in a kebab shop.

Here's a small list of what to expect from this update:
[list]
[*] improved gamepad support
[*] new settings UI with more settings to tune the game to your liking
[*] in-game access to the settings menu
[*] new level select UI
[*] new fonts and animations for various UI elements
[*] easier to navigate between a custom level and the level editor
[*] rich presence for Steam
[*] improved main menu lighting
[*] a small revamp to the ending cinematic
[*] small bug fixes
[/list]

Please let us know what you think on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/745400]Community Hub[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/NeCKNjC2zR]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: New Levels, Achievements and many more!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31047400/249a3007b3389de3b0987205d362d51e9c6e0665.png[/img]

[h1]New levels![/h1]
[b]5 snow levels have been added, more challenging than any before.[/b]

[h1]New ability![/h1]
[b]We've added a new ability which allows you to slide and it has a 1 second cooldown, unlike jumping and dashing which feel like they take an eternity to recharge.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31047400/d889ed3ad18aa8804e8dbf43c07dc049a5040af6.png[/img]

[h1]New obstacles & mechanics![/h1]
[b]Along with the levels, we've added new obstacles and mechanics,
like crows that obscure your vision and wet snow that makes you slip like an almost-drifting AE86 when Takumi is not driving it.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31047400/854d78a72ce9088d51c3cf135008688505fc8b71.png[/img]

[h1]New Achievements![/h1]
[b]If you've already thought that this couldn't get any better, we've also added 6 more achievements for you to have a little something to do besides passing those "ez pz" levels.[/b]

[h1]Improvements and Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]The menus will now scale properly for every resolution and aspect ratio!
    [*]Cars colliders have been updated to better match their shape.
    [*]We've updated some of the keybinds for controllers thanks to [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/skullkid00700]Anime Freak[/url]'s feedback.
    [*]The player can no longer win and die at the same time.
    [*]Other bug fixes that will make your experience a little better.
[/list]

notes.title: Controller Support
notes.content:
[h1]Hello there, dear kebab lovers![/h1]

[b]In the last patch we've added partial controller support. 
That means you can use your controller for playing the game, but you'll have to use your mouse from time to time to navigate the menus.[/b]

Have fun!
